title: NostrAgent: A Decentralized Identity and Delegation Architecture for Sovereign Agentic Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.22944v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous AI agents increasingly act across organizational boundaries on behalf of human operators: they invoke third-party services, delegate subtasks to other agents, and pay for metered resources. Deploying such agents safely requires five capabilities that today live in separate systems: persistent identity, scoped delegation, peer trust, discovery, and payment. Existing approaches root these in centralized authorities or cover only subsets, so authority, trust, and payment fracture exactly where autonomy needs continuity: when a key rotates or a delegation must be revoked. We present NostrAgent, a decentralized architecture that unifies all five over Nostr relays using three custom event kinds: Kind 38100 identity declarations authenticated by BIP340 Schnorr signatures with pre-rotation commitments, Kind 38101 scoped delegation chains whose every hop verifiably narrows granted capabilities, and Kind 38102 peer attestations forming

translated_title: NostrAgent：面向主权智能体系统的去中心化身份与委托架构
translated_abstract: 自主AI智能体越来越多地代表人类操作者跨组织边界行动：它们调用第三方服务、将子任务委托给其他智能体，并为计量资源付费。安全地部署此类智能体需要五项目前分散在不同系统中的能力：持久身份、范围受限的委托、对等信任、发现和支付。现有方法将这些能力根植于中心化权威机构，或仅覆盖其中一部分，导致权威、信任和支付恰恰在自主性需要连续性的地方发生断裂：例如密钥轮换或需要撤销委托之时。我们提出了NostrAgent，这是一种去中心化架构，通过三种自定义事件类型在Nostr中继上统一了上述五项能力：Kind 38100身份声明，由BIP340 Schnorr签名认证并带有预轮换承诺；Kind 38101范围受限的委托链，其每一跳都可验证地收窄所授予的能力；Kind 38102对等证明，形成……
tldr: NostrAgent提出了一种基于Nostr中继的去中心化架构，通过三种自定义事件类型（带预轮换承诺的身份声明、逐跳收窄权限的委托链、对等证明）统一解决了自主AI智能体所需的持久身份、范围受限委托、对等信任、发现和支付五大能力，避免了中心化权威在密钥轮换或委托撤销时造成的信任断裂。
en_tdlr: NostrAgent is a decentralized architecture over Nostr relays that unifies persistent identity, scoped delegation, peer trust, discovery, and payment for autonomous AI agents through three custom event kinds, with verifiable capability narrowing at every delegation hop.
